phases.name: Scope and pilot selection

steps.action: Select the context and record its chapters, physical PDF pages and printed page labels.
List the supported transactions and entry modes exactly as the source states them.
Record exclusions, including look-alike programs and generic card processing that must not inherit fleet rules.
Obtain SME sign-off on the scope record.

deliverables: Context scope record in the context training package
acceptanceCriteria: Every scoped page lies inside the chapter bookmarks

phases.name: Source inventory

steps.action: Classify every scoped section as overview, rule, table, card layout, example, cross-reference or note.
Anchor each item to a page-local quote, page ID and page text hash.
Prove that every PDF bookmark inside the scope is covered by at least one item.
List cross-references to ATL105 and to document-local Petroleum appendices.

acceptanceCriteria: All quotes resolve on their stated page

phases.name: Version reconciliation

steps.action: Compare every inventoried rule with ATL105 2026-3 and 2026-4 using quoted, page-local evidence.
Assign a disposition: aligned, Petroleum narrows ATL105, Petroleum-only, interpretation required, distinct program or potential conflict.
Verify claimed absences by searching both ATL105 releases at build time.
Raise an owned question for every non-aligned item and obtain SME dispositions.

acceptanceCriteria: No unresolved conflict remains in scope

phases.name: Table and card-layout extraction

steps.action: Convert track layouts into structured fields whose row text is verified on the source page.
Extract BIN ranges and enumerations; check that every page repeating them agrees.
Check source examples against the layouts, BIN ranges and check-digit rule.
Keep Petroleum appendix identities document-local and send anomalies to source review.

deliverables: Structured card and field catalog with example checks
acceptanceCriteria: Example anomalies are reviewed against the original PDF

phases.name: Context matrix

steps.action: Map supported transactions to ATL105 transaction types and full Prompt Codes.
Combine transactions with entry modes, prompt requirements and AFP or receipt flows.
Mark every combination supported, unsupported or review-required with evidence.

acceptanceCriteria: Every combination has a disposition and evidence

phases.name: Independent BR derivation

steps.action: Write atomic BRs from reconciled rules without using AI producer output.
Attach source anchors, context applicability and ATL105 dependencies to every BR.
Reject duplicate, blended or unanchored BRs.

acceptanceCriteria: Every BR is atomic and anchored

phases.name: TS, TC and TD chains

steps.action: Derive positive, negative and boundary scenarios for every BR.
Create test cases and concrete test data; flag placeholders.
Validate canonical BR to TS to TC to TD traceability.

acceptanceCriteria: Every BR has a complete chain
Placeholders are never counted as executable

phases.name: AFP and specialized flows

steps.action: Model AFP pre-authorization, completion, offline receipts and retry rules.
Model reversal and follow-on card-data rules.
Link every state transition to evidence and a test chain.

acceptanceCriteria: Every transition has evidence and a chain

phases.name: Serialization and mutation

steps.action: Serialize test data with the existing ATL105 converter.
Add mutations for check digit, BIN boundary, product totals and masking.
Prove that the validator rejects every mutation.

acceptanceCriteria: Valid data serializes and every mutation is caught

phases.name: AI artifact intake

steps.action: Obtain an AI-produced Petroleum BR/TS/TC/TD package.
Compare it with the independent package for coverage, correctness, traceability and test data.
Triage and track every difference.

acceptanceCriteria: Every difference has a triage decision

steps.action: Execute ready test data on the host or simulator.
Record actual outcomes against independent oracles.
Record SME or TBA approval before promoting the context.

guardrails: Fleet rules apply only to their card program and never to generic card processing.
Petroleum 2025-1 supplements ATL105 2026-3 and 2026-4; it does not replace either release.
Retrieval results are leads, not approved rules.
Executable means ready to run; only actually executed test data counts as executed.
No status is promoted without source evidence and a recorded SME decision.
